name: Payment authenticity
rule: EVT-006 must come from a signed PayFast webhook with amount = invoice and a unique idempotency key; duplicates are ignored; no work starts on unsigned or mismatched events.

name: Consent and lawful basis
rule: POPIA fields, terms and PermissionKey must be complete before any work; cross-border transfer (Zoho EU) disclosed under s72.

name: Input completeness
rule: Schema-valid inputs only; bounded clarification loop (3 rounds / 2 business days); delivery clock starts at intake completion, not payment.

name: Source grounding
rule: Every factual claim cites a permitted, licensed and fresh source with date and grade; faithfulness score at or above archetype threshold.

name: Numeric integrity
rule: All numbers come from deterministic calculators; totals reconcile; models pass FAST checks; no figure typed by a language model.

name: Independent evaluation
rule: A model from a different family scores the draft on the archetype rubric; maximum 3 generate–score cycles; exit when gain < 2 points.

name: Hallucination and contradiction detection
rule: Claim-level detectors flag unsupported or conflicting statements; flagged text is removed or sourced before release.

name: Originality and licence
rule: Text and images are checked for copying; only licensed images, fonts and data are used.

name: Brand compliance
rule: TBCA brand kit (Infogram Business brand kit, document templates) applied; template lint passes.

name: Accessibility
rule: PDFs and web outputs meet WCAG 2.2 AA: tagged headings, alt text, contrast, captions on all HeyGen videos.

name: Privacy and PII
rule: Personal data minimised and redacted where not needed; video and chart content contain no third-party PII.

name: Professional boundary
rule: Legal, tax, audit, regulated valuation, EIA and engineering opinions are routed to a registered partner and signed; otherwise the output states it is not a regulated opinion.

name: Tier conformance
rule: Automated check that every key issue, every tier element, the page range and the promised video and charts are present before release.

name: Accountable human release
rule: At NOW every order is released by a qualified person who sees all detector flags; the decision is an EvidenceEvent. L4 exception-based release only after BP-29 promotion.

name: Version, hash and manifest
rule: Each artefact is versioned, hashed (SHA-256) and listed in an evidence manifest delivered with it.

name: Rights and watermark
rule: Licence class (L1–L4) stamped; Basic/Standard watermarked with client name; redistribution rights stated.

name: SLA protection
rule: A breach predictor watches every job; at-risk jobs are escalated and the client is told before the promise is missed; compensation per CPA.

name: Video integrity (HeyGen)
rule: Video scripts are generated only from the released deliverable; digital-twin avatars require recorded consent; no impersonation of third parties; captions and disclaimer frame.

name: Chart integrity (Infogram)
rule: Charts are data-bound from the Artefact Factory (never hand-drawn); a copy per job; on Infogram failure the native renderer uses identical data.

name: Cost ceiling and kill switch
rule: Per-job runtime cost ceiling; kill switch at eight levels; fail-closed on anomaly.

name: Satisfaction capture and remedy
rule: CSAT survey at acceptance or day 7; scores below the tier minimum trigger root-cause review and a free corrective revision.

name: Correction and recall
rule: Up to 2 revisions in the aftercare term; serious errors trigger recall within 24 hours, re-issue under full review and archetype demotion to L3.

name: Freshness and expiry
rule: Every data-based output shows an as-at date and an expiry; Premium includes a refresh trigger.

name: Fairness and tone
rule: People-related outputs (HR, CVs, screening) are checked for bias and respectful language; automated decisions disclosed.

name: File security
rule: Files are malware-scanned; Excel is macro-free; links are private and expire.

name: Model control
rule: Production models are pinned; a new model is promoted only after shadow evaluation passes on every affected archetype; one-release rollback.

name: No double charging
rule: Reuse and freshness matrix prevents charging twice for the same evidence; credits applied automatically.

name: Value-for-money check
rule: Release is blocked unless every beyond-benchmark element promised for the tier (video, interactive charts, AI Q&A, tracker) is present and working.

name: Localisation
rule: Language, currency, country rules and regulator names match the client context resolver.

name: Full audit trail
rule: Every act writes an EvidenceEvent; UNKNOWN is never zero; missing evidence halts the job.
